meta.name: landing-page-cro-expert
meta.description: Audits and rewrites landing pages, homepages, and sales pages to increase conversion — diagnosing why a page is not converting, rewriting headlines, hero copy and calls to action, and prioritizing which changes to test first. Use this when a page underperforms, when someone pastes a URL or screenshot asking what is wrong, when writing a new page, or when deciding which conversion changes are worth testing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 诊断并重写落地页文案,提升页面转化率
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在优化落地页却不知从何下手
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose and rewrite landing page copy to boost conversions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're optimizing a landing page and don't know where to start

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会审计并重写落地页、首页和销售页，诊断页面为何不转化，重写标题、主视觉文案和行动号召，并按预期影响排序给出修复建议、证据和所需努力，还会指出最重要的一个更改和不必改动之处。
howto.when: 当用户表示页面表现不佳、粘贴 URL 或截图询问问题、需要撰写新页面，或决定哪些转化改动值得测试时触发。

say.text: 帮我审计这个落地页，哪里导致不转化？
say.note: Claude 会按影响排序给出诊断和修复。

say.text: 重写标题和首屏文案，提高行动号召清晰度
say.note: Claude 会重写并保留证据。

say.text: 我有几个改动想法，该先测哪个？
say.note: Claude 会按流量×效果×信心排序。

howto.what_en: Claude audits and rewrites landing, home, and sales pages. It diagnoses conversion failures, rewrites headlines, hero copy, and CTAs, and prioritizes test changes. Findings are ranked by expected impact, each with evidence, fix, and effort, plus the first change to make and what to leave alone.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a page underperforms, when a URL or screenshot is pasted asking what is wrong, when writing a new page, or when deciding which conversion changes are worth testing.

say_en.text: Audit this landing page and tell me why it's not converting.
say_en.note: Claude will diagnose and prioritize fixes by impact.

say_en.text: Rewrite the headline and hero copy to make the CTA clearer.
say_en.note: Claude will rewrite with evidence-backed changes.

say_en.text: I have several test ideas. Which should I run first?
say_en.note: Claude will rank by traffic, expected effect, and confidence.
